WITH filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk,
           ss.ss_quantity,
           ss.ss_list_price,
           ss.ss_coupon_amt,
           ss.ss_sales_price
    FROM customer_demographics cd
    JOIN store_sales ss
      ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
     AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
     AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'W'
     AND cd.cd_education_status = 'College'
    JOIN date_dim d
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
     AND d.d_year = 2001
    JOIN promotion p
      ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
     AND (p.p_channel_email = 'N' OR p.p_channel_event = 'N')
),
top_item_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (i.i_item_id) i.i_item_id
    FROM filtered_sales fs
    JOIN item i
      ON fs.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    ORDER BY i.i_item_id
    LIMIT 100
)
SELECT i.i_item_id,
       avg(fs.ss_quantity) AS agg1,
       avg(fs.ss_list_price) AS agg2,
       avg(fs.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
       avg(fs.ss_sales_price) AS agg4
FROM top_item_ids t
JOIN item i
  ON i.i_item_id = t.i_item_id
JOIN filtered_sales fs
  ON fs.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id
ORDER BY i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
